title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f9v whole passage must carry a source-keyed Viola trait inventory
summary: Before target reading, a single independently identified historical Viola entry would fix a small ordered inventory of distinctive observations and explicit absences, rather than a modern list assembled to fit f9v. A proposed complete f9v reading with fochor as the owner must preserve these predicates and their roles across the passage. If no source entry and length capacity exist, the result is missing input, not a word confirmation.

design.mechanism: The alleged plant name owns a source-written set of discriminating traits throughout one complete entry.
design.unit: One whole historical Viola entry with its exact written claims, the whole admitted f9v prose unit, and matched non-Viola source entries.
design.contrast: specific ordered trait-and-exception reading versus a generic Herbal paragraph compatible with many plants
design.prediction: A frozen reading locates every source-keyed positive and negative predicate under fochor without reassigning plant parts or importing traits from the picture.
design.scope: Raw hypothesis; primary owner and target capacity unknown; no manuscript access for idea generation.
